✨ AI Project Setup

LLM interchange schema v5
Let an LLM do the first-pass setup, then direct and refine it here.

You can build the whole project at once or work one Generation at a time. For a new project, copy the new-project instructions. After Generation 1 is in the Composer, use Copy next-Generation context, describe only what should happen next, and the LLM can return an append JSON that adds Generation 2 without replacing Generation 1.

Media labels and reusable Picture routing

Project image names are not automatically H3 Picture slots. Use P## only when you truly mean a fixed physical ComfyUI Picture input. Environment views are normally reusable library media: name them by environment + view, then route them into the available Picture inputs for each Generation.

Recommended pattern: keep recurring character/object references pinned when that makes your workflow easier, but let environment views reuse the remaining Picture inputs. Example with four pinned Subjects: Jungle Clearing views can use Pictures 5–6, Jungle Road can reuse Picture 5, and Broken Bridge views can reuse Pictures 5–7. Different Environment nodes may intentionally share those same slot numbers because only the selected Environment is active in a Generation.

P01_Jane_CHARACTER_SHEET.pngFixed/pinned Picture 1 · character identityP02_John_CHARACTER_SHEET.pngFixed/pinned Picture 2 · character identityENV01_JungleClearing_V01_WIDE.pngLogical environment view · no permanent Picture slot impliedENV01_JungleClearing_V02_SHED_SIDE.pngSecond view of the same EnvironmentENV02_JungleRoad_V01_WIDE.pngAnother Environment · may also route to Picture 5ENV03_BrokenBridge_V03_RAMP_DETAIL.pngThird Broken Bridge view · may route to Picture 7 when that Environment is activeG01_JaneJohn_CONT_BLOCKING.pngContinuity image · add P## only if its physical slot is already decidedA01_Jane_VOICE.wavAudio 1 · fixed audio input when knownV01_Performance_REFERENCE.mp4Video 1 · fixed video input when known

When giving files to the AI: label each Environment consistently and distinguish its views (WIDE, APPROACH, SHED_SIDE, RAMP_DETAIL, etc.). The order you upload images or a name like “image 10” is only a project-media identifier unless you explicitly say it is physical Picture 10. After import, verify the Picture chips on each Environment node match what you will actually connect in ComfyUI for that Generation.

Instructions preview

Import AI Setup JSON

Paste the JSON returned by the LLM or open a .json file. Pasted JSON is checked automatically. The JSON’s operation field decides what happens: replace_project replaces the whole project, while append_generations (returned when you use Copy next-Generation context) merges the new Generation(s) into the current project. Structural/schema problems block import; Prompt Check problems are shown clearly but may still be imported so you can fix them inside the Composer.

H3 Adherence Field Guide

Condensed working notes on prompt adherence, reference routing, and field-aware prompt clarity. OFFICIALfrom MiniMax docs · COMMUNITYthird-party guide · TESTEDreproducible community test.

Camera Language Guide

Build one clear camera instruction. Describe the subject’s action separately, name physical subject sides only when needed, and state camera endpoints instead of relying on screen direction or rotation terminology.

Recommended sentence order

1. Preserve action
Keep recorded performance and path unchanged.
2. Opening camera
State shot size, height, position, and lens aim.
3. Camera move
Name only the camera’s physical path.
4. Ending camera
State the final shot size, position, height, and lens aim.

Useful terminology

Push in / pull back: move the camera closer to or farther from the subject. Truck: move laterally. Pedestal: move the entire camera vertically. Pan / tilt: rotate the lens without moving the camera through space. Arc: move around a subject between named opening and ending positions. Physical right/left: the subject’s own sides, not the viewer’s screen.

Insert a tested phrase

These buttons add concise wording to the active custom camera instruction. Replace bracketed placeholders where shown.

Proven concise pattern

Camera: use a wide, full-body shot of the primary subject with the immediate location visible. Place the camera on the physical right-hand side of the primary subject, measured from the subject’s own perspective, and show that right side in profile. Travel parallel to the primary subject’s recorded path at matching speed. Keep the lens aimed at the primary subject and maintain the selected framing throughout.

Audio

Use this only when there is no dialogue, ambience, or physical sound in the scene. Non-diegetic music is controlled separately below.

Use this for ambience or recurring physical sound that persists across the Generation. Put one-off impacts, footsteps, engine starts, roars, and other synchronized events inside the relevant Shot.

Add only sounds that recur across this Generation. One-off synchronized events belong in the Shot Sound section and do not carry forward automatically.

This music setting carries forward to a fresh Generation by default. Music heard by characters is diegetic and belongs in the relevant shot, not this field.
